assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE transparent PNG game vehicle sprite, a missing rotation of the EXACT vehicle in the reference image. Reference is the original electric bus rear three-quarter sprite. Preserve its identity, body shape, proportions, hand-painted style, dark outlines, materials, colors, wheels, cargo and roof details. Change only the viewing direction: show its FRONT and one side, driving diagonally toward the BOTTOM LEFT of the image. Its front bumper and headlights must be at the lower left end, rear at the opposite upper end. See roof from above at the same isometric elevation as reference. Vehicle long ground axis follows a 30-degree diagonal. This is a front three-quarter view, NOT a rear view and NOT a mirrored rear view. For bus preserve ivory roof and teal lower body; for truck preserve yellow utility pickup and timber/tools load; for van preserve blue body, white horizontal stripe, roof bars and wrench emblem. Only depict the referenced vehicle, no other vehicles. Center complete vehicle with 6 percent transparent margin, tight square composition. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no backdrop, no text or direction labels. A subtle contact shadow only.
